contentPattern.structure: N side-by-side step columns, each = numbered step-badge image + heading + description

suitableFor: numbered process / how-to steps laid out side-by-side (Step 1 / Step 2 / Step 3)
'how to make a claim' style step columns with a badge image + title + description per step
equal-width instructional columns each led by an icon/badge
notSuitableFor: repeating image + title + description teaser items linking to detail pages (use cards-teaser)
free-form two-column rich content (use the vanilla columns pattern)

usage.notes: Car-insurance 'How to make a claim' section (#basic-18933): 3 side-by-side steps, each with a lightblue step-number badge image (badge-step-lightblue-01/02/03), an H3 title and a short description. Step 3 contains a 'Make a claim' link and a MyAccount link.
